CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2547 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a. Bus nonce: c2c5075c4ebcb40ffb1e164a8ee4f777. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a` or `Fix review: blocked 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: c2c5075c4ebcb40ffb1e164a8ee4f777`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2547 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2547-c2c5075c`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Markers-only re-read for PR #2547 at head 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a (unchanged; verify with git rev-parse of the PR head and stop if it moved). The earlier verdict(s) at this exact head are PR comments (gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/issues/2547/comments; the last 'Fix review: merge 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a' one). Their merge verdict stands. The merge train's pre-flight parks the PR because some of its notes are read as findings without a Carry marker. Read tools/audit/carry_audit.py (module docstring: the grammar), run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster over the earlier verdict text (git fetch origin handoff/audit-r10-roster first) and list the unrouted item ids. Write a new verdict: first line exactly 'Fix review: merge 90bab078d19dd6aebba140fa360576b7780a560a', a short statement that this is a markers-only re-issue of the earlier verdict routing its items (re-check only: head unchanged, git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> clean, required check-runs not red; pending: say which), then one marker per unrouted item id: 'Carry: dismissed <reason of two or more words> (item <id>)' where the observation is deliberately left as is, or 'Carry: <GROUP-ID> (item <id>)' only for a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster. Do not invent groups. Do not re-review the code. Then run carry_audit on your own verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Put fresh evidence in ev/ including ev/HEAD.txt with the full head.
